name: methodical
description: Methodical gated engineering with shared native routing and portable project records. Requires supported native hooks and Node.js.

decider.title: Decider model
decider.description: Sits every deciding seat: the plan, plan review, and the correctness, rigor and code-grounded review seats. Each role runs at a fixed effort; this sets only the model.

worker.title: Worker model
worker.description: Writes up solutions and sits the research and simplicity seats; your session orchestrates and builds at its own model and effort. Each role runs at a fixed effort; this sets only the model.

census.title: Census model
census.description: Search, census and the North Star check. Each role runs at a fixed effort; this sets only the model.

backstop.title: Backstop model
backstop.description: Sits the escalated review: the final re-review of a lean or full unit and, at full, the code-grounded, rigor and correctness seats. Set it to the decider's model to turn the extra pass into a repeat. Each role runs at a fixed effort; this sets only the model.

nudgePercent.title: Compound offer (percent of the window)
nudgePercent.description: Offers a compound checkpoint when the conversation reaches this percent of the model's context window, from 1 to 100 (100 turns this offer off). It only offers; it never compacts.

nudgeReserve.title: Second offer reserve (tokens)
nudgeReserve.description: A second offer, before the host's compaction threshold, comes when this many tokens or fewer remain, so there is room to compound first. A value that is not positive uses the default; the reserve is never more than a fifth of the threshold.

offer.title: Offer to compound before compacting
offer.description: on: the early warning, the question at a typed /compact and the line after a compaction. off: none of them (the compaction summary is still asked to keep your lessons and rulings).
